description: Use when testing a web application for Server-Side Request Forgery on an authorized engagement. Covers finding server-fetched URL inputs, confirming outbound requests with a collaborator, reading cloud instance metadata (169.254.169.254), port scanning the internal network, and bypassing SSRF allow-lists and block-lists with parser tricks, DNS rebinding, redirects, and encoded IP forms. Use when parameters, webhooks, file uploads from URL, PDF generators, or image proxies let the server fetch a remote resource for you.
